name: ui-refine
title_zh: 页面 UI 精修师：视觉对齐、组件复用
tagline_zh: 接手已有页面，不重写只精修：对齐视觉风格、抹掉原生拼装感、统一 Tailwind 用法，让散落的组件终于像一家人。
tagline_en: Refine existing pages, not rebuild them: align styles, kill native-assembly feel, unify Tailwind usage, make.
desc_en: Use for UI Layer refinement of existing pages: align visual style, reduce native assembly feel, replace inconsistent Tailwind usage, reuse component libraries and existing components, and improve UI consistency.
why_zh: 它不碰业务逻辑，专治 UI 层「哪哪都不对劲」——从视觉到代码习惯逐项收敛，改完的页面既好看又好维护。
why_en: It stays out of business logic and attacks the UI layer's 'everything feels off' — converging visuals and code habits so pages.
limit_zh: 只处理已有页面的 UI 层，不新增功能、不重构架构；需要项目里已有组件库或设计规范可参照，否则只能做表面统一。
limit_en: UI-layer only: no new features, no architecture refactor. Needs an existing component library or design tokens to align to; otherwise it's just.
title_en: UI Refiner: Align Visuals, Reuse Components, Unify Tailwind
